metadata.description: Claude Code plugin for @ghostmind-dev/ensemble: skills that let an agent build, prove and tune typed-decision runners.

plugins.name: ensemble
plugins.description: Operate @ghostmind-dev/ensemble runners end to end: build a decision graph, prove it, dry-run it for $0, run it, watch a live run and stop or answer it, read and tune the runs, and host runners over MCP or A2A.
